headline: Shares of the Indian IT services company Hexaware jumped about 12% after it signed a multi-year partnership with Anthropic.
score_reason: Partnership was announced on 8 Oct and today's news is the share reaction, so lowered 5 to 4.
importance_line: Shows a large IT services firm tying itself closely to one AI model supplier, which matters to its clients and shareholders; the article gives no financial terms, and the share jump is a market reaction, not a measure of the deal's value.
source: Business Standard, citing an exchange filing
summary: Business Standard reports, citing an exchange filing, that Hexaware Technologies became a Preferred Partner in Anthropic's Claude Partner Network and will bring Claude, Anthropic's AI model, into two of its platforms: Zerovity for software engineering and AgentVerse for building and governing AI agents. Its shares rose about 12% in early trading on Friday 9 October, a fifth straight daily gain, and the filing says it has more than 1,100 Claude-certified professionals.
notes: ET Now page blocked; text read on Business Standard. The 8 Oct announcement date is from other outlets' headlines.
